description: Find pools for an exact token pair across 11 Sui venues. Both token orders are searched. Incomplete venue searches carry a next_call that resumes from their last cursor; offset pages the pools found in one call. Totals are lower bounds until every venue completes.

offset.description: Start the pool list at this index (default 0). A response that leaves pools out gives the next offset in omitted.next_call.

protocol.description: Filter by venue: cetus, deepbook, turbos, bluemove, bluefin, momentum, flowx_clmm, flowx_v2, magma, aftermath, kriya_v2. Searches all if omitted.

token_a.description: First token: verified symbol (e.g. 'SUI') or full coin type

token_b.description: Second token: verified symbol (e.g. 'USDC') or full coin type

venue_cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a venue's next_call. Resumes that venue's search; use the protocol supplied in the call.

name: find_pools
title: Find pools
